title: Tensor and unit laws for normalized realization reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D and an arbitrary FamilyCore C [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data]. Assume its comparison satisfies integralRealizationAgreement for all finite integral constructible representatives. Its fixed SpaceData includes the finite quotient-completion tensor normalizations. Then the comparison obeys the tensor and coefficient-unit equations of Family for its specified ambient ReindexTensor and canonical common-stage pullback tensor and unit comparisons. These equations are for every common-stage pair, including pairs originally represented over different finite coefficient fields. No comparison data or identity/composition/Hom law is constructed.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; arbitrary scheme-isomorphism reindexing, including semilinear Frobenius; old step 12; HRS: literature/hemo-richarz-scholbach-constructible-sheaves_arXiv-2305.18131.pdf; precise map normalization is the agent-written argument retained in report.md.

proof.text: Introduce T,U,g and the two tensor inputs. Specialize the given integral normalization to this g and apply the fixed-isomorphism tensor-square theorem. Separately introduce T,U,g and apply the fixed-isomorphism coefficient-unit theorem with the same specialized normalization. Pair these two universally quantified conclusions. Both applications use precisely C.data, C.comparison, C.pullTensor and C.unit_spec, with no reconstruction of the family.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_reindexing_tensor
    (C : FamilyCore l D)
    (h_integral_normalization : ∀ (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
          (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)),
        letI := (C.data T).units
        letI := (C.data U).units
        integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (C.data T).realization (C.data U).realization
          (C.ring T U g) E (C.integral T U g E) (C.comparison T U g)) :
    (∀ (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
      (M N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left),
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map ((C.data U).tensor.tensor.hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      (C.comparison T U g).inv.app ((commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left).obj
        (M, N)) ≫
      (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom M N).hom =
    (C.pullTensor T U g).tensor.hom.app
        ((ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj M,
         (ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj N) ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
        ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app M) ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app N)) ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.tensor.hom.app ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj M,
        (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj N))
    ∧ (∀ (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left),
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map (C.data U).tensor.unit.hom ≫
      (C.comparison T U g).inv.app (pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left) ≫
      (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (C.unit_spec T U g).exists.choose.hom =
    (pullUnit l T.base.left g.hom (C.pullTensor T U g)).hom ≫ (C.data T).tensor.unit.hom)
